name: LiquidSiri
tagline: 为 Siri 带来 NewSiri 屏幕流光与 SiriAI 玻璃界面。
description: LiquidSiri 提供 NewSiri 与 SiriAI 两种可切换的 Siri 外观，并保留系统原有的识别与对话能力。
NewSiri 在唤起时呈现屏幕扫光和彩色边缘流光，交互过程中会随说话产生自然的局部波动。
SiriAI 使用玻璃球体与回答卡片，可调整位置、大小、圆角和折射效果。
notice: 本插件仅调整 Siri 外观，不解锁 Apple 智能功能。
features: NewSiri 屏幕扫光、彩色边缘流光与语音响应波动
SiriAI 玻璃球体、回答卡片及外观参数调节
简体中文、繁体中文和英文设置界面
iOS 18 及以上可避免与系统原生流光重复显示；仍使用球体 Siri 的设备可继续选择 NewSiri
compatibility: 在支持系统原生流光的 iOS 18 设备上，NewSiri 可能不会作为可选效果显示；球体 Siri 设备不受此限制
usage: 安装插件后重新加载桌面
进入“设置 → LiquidSiri”选择 NewSiri 或 SiriAI
切换效果或启用状态后再次重新加载桌面

changes: 修复 iOS 15 打开 LiquidSiri 设置时可能崩溃的问题。
修正设置入口，并增强旧版 iOS 设置列表的刷新兼容性。
新增 NewSiri 屏幕扫光、彩色边缘流光与语音响应波动效果。
新增 SiriAI 玻璃球体与回答卡片，并支持调整位置、大小、圆角和折射效果。
新增简体中文、繁体中文和英文设置界面，并增强 iOS 18 原生流光兼容性。

en.name: LiquidSiri
en.tagline: Give Siri a new look with NewSiri edge lighting and the SiriAI glass interface.
description: LiquidSiri provides two switchable Siri appearances, NewSiri and SiriAI, while preserving the system's existing recognition and conversation behavior.
NewSiri displays an activation sweep and colorful edge lighting, with natural localized motion while you speak.
SiriAI presents a glass orb and answer cards with adjustable position, size, corner radius, and refraction.
en.notice: This tweak only changes Siri's appearance and does not unlock Apple Intelligence features.
features: NewSiri activation sweeps, colorful edge lighting, and speech-responsive motion
SiriAI glass orb, answer cards, and adjustable appearance controls
Settings localized in English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese
On iOS 18 and later, duplicate native edge lighting is avoided; devices that still use the Siri orb can continue to select NewSiri
compatibility: On iOS 18 devices with native Siri edge lighting, NewSiri may not appear as an available effect; devices using the Siri orb are unaffected
usage: Open Settings → LiquidSiri and choose NewSiri or SiriAI
Respring again after changing the effect or enabled state

changes: Fixed a crash that could occur when opening LiquidSiri settings on iOS 15.
Corrected the Settings entry and improved list refresh compatibility on older iOS versions.
Added NewSiri activation sweeps, colorful edge lighting, and speech-responsive motion.
Added the SiriAI glass orb and answer cards with adjustable position, size, corner radius, and refraction.
Added Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and English settings, with improved compatibility for native Siri lighting on iOS 18.
